Less waiting. More computing.

How we work

Every iteration leaves a better starting point.

  1. 01

    Define a test

    Start from the question and the workload it should serve.

  2. 02

    Measure the baseline

    Profile topology, memory and latency before tuning anything.

  3. 03

    Challenge the conclusion

    Re-run, cross-check, publish with the conditions.

  4. 04

    Keep the evidence

    What we learn becomes the next starting point.
